$comment: Local Doc Index sweep configuration. Copy to config.json next to sweep.mjs (git-ignored) and fill in. Secrets belong in environment variables via {"$env": "NAME"} — never commit them.

paths.$comment: OneDrive-synced local roots. sourceLibrary = the LocationReferencing Documents library; sidecarLibrary = the LRS Doc Index library (sidecars + media/).

llm.$comment: provider 'aibuilder' calls the SAME AI Builder custom prompt the cloud flow uses — same model, same tenant-hosted prompt text, same AI Builder credit metering — via the Dataverse Web API, authenticating with the graph app above (add it as an application user in the Power Platform environment; Local_Setup.md §3). environmentUrl = the environment's Dataverse URL (Power Platform admin center → Environments); modelId = the flow's Run_prompt recordId. Alternative: "provider": "anthropic" (Claude-account OAuth via `ant auth login`, or auth 'apiKey') executes prompts/DocIndex_Prompt.md instead — see local/CHANGES.md v1.1.

sweep.$comment: Mirrors flow v2.8 Config. Values below are the v2.8 defaults; keep them in sync with STATUS when the flow config changes.
